fulltitle: Kindness Makes Me Stronger | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Kindness Makes me Stronger Read Aloud ~ Reading Pioneers Academy

If you want to teach your children the magic of Kindness, this cute picture book is the right choice for you. It will clearly show your little ones how easy and joyful it is to be kind. Spending time on his grandparents' farm little Nick meets new friends – funny animals that don't behave nicely. Having faced a great challenge our little hero manages to teach his new friends the power of kindness, caring, and compassion. This kids' book about kindness is filled with colorful illustrations and charming rhymes. Guiding through an exciting story and dialogues with animal characters this story will help your little ones in many ways:

to express their empathy, compassion, and gratitude
to respect both elders and younger ones, together with their peers
to help those in need and to appreciate true friendship
to acquire nice manners

”I Choose to Calm My Anger” is a story with social-emotional learning (SEL) in mind. It has been praised by teachers and therapists worldwide.

title: Honesty is My Superpower Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Honesty is My Superpower Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Do you want to teach your children how to be honest?
Children are always faced with a normal dilemma - should I lie or tell the truth?

Our job is to teach them to make the right choice and more importantly, show that honesty is not just saying truth, honesty also means your actions are truthful too.

Model honesty
Little Tommy loves everything other kids love but what he likes most is spending time with his older brother Nao.

Respond thoughtfully to lying
With the help of his brother, Nao, Tommy will learn the effects of lying and how it impacts the feelings of others. Even when he thinks it’s just a joke.

This book helps to teach children:
to understand why lying isn’t the best option,
to understand the consequence of not telling the truth,
to learn to take responsibility for their actions,
not to be afraid to stand up for themselves,
to understand how good it feels to tell the truth,
to understand that lies hurt not only other people but also their feelings.
•••

The power of truth will help you never to tell lies.

•••

‘Honesty is my Superpower’ suitable for preschoolers to early readers, this book aims to teach your children to be honest and fair.

title: Acceptance is my Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Acceptance is my Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Do you want your children to honor, celebrate, and see the beauty in our differences?
We are all different. And whilst children are often wonderful at accepting differences easily, there are times when a lack of understanding can result in hurtful words or actions.  As adults, it is our responsibility to teach children that differences are not flaws but are, in fact, our super powers.

Lisa, a primary school student with a love of singing, learns just that in ‘Acceptance is my Superpower’ when a cruel comment from someone she regards as a friend leads her down a path of discovery of the true meaning of diversity and how it can be applied to everyone.

Laid out as a charming poem with colourful illustrations, children will delight in learning:
• How to love themselves
• How to accept others
• How to control negative emotions
• How to share their newfound knowledge

Learning by example
The examples in this story are there to teach children that their differences are not to be ridiculed but instead, celebrated. When Lisa learns this valuable lesson in the book and then shares that knowledge with the person who upset her, we realise the importance of helping children understand the world would be a very boring place indeed if we were all the same.

•••

“Just like all the petals on all these different flowers,
Diversity is beautiful and gives us superpowers!”
Please join me and Lucas spread the word to all you know,
Acceptance is our superpower and together we will grow. 

•••

From the bestselling author of Kindness is my Superpower
Join Lisa and Lucas, as together, they learn the most valuable lesson of all - they have a superpower - their acceptance.

Lucas is prepared for the highly anticipated bike race, fueled by his determination to win. However, he soon faces the moral dilemma of achieving victory through cheating.

Guide your kids in making the right choices.

By considering the consequences of their actions, they can avoid a gloomy outcome and instead illuminate their day with bright possibilities.

Teach children about important concepts in an easy and engaging manner, such as:
Choices
Consequences
Responsibility
Making decisions
Considering the consequences
Being responsible
Embracing mistakes and admitting when wrong

title: Patience is My Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Patience is My Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
"Are we there yet?", "How much longer?".
You've probably heard it countless times. Kids are impatient, but it's our job to teach them that waiting is worth it.
Waiting is not easy, especially for children.

Little Dan is an eight-year-old boy who likes to do many things besides waiting. When he finds out that he has to wait a whole week until he visits his grandparents, Dan becomes upset and very impatient. But through interacting with his grandparents, little Dan will learn that he can do and learn many things while he waits.
He will realize that waiting can produce delicious morsels like grandma's pie or even new life like a chicken hatching from an egg.

"Patience is my superpower" is a children's book about patience containing beautiful illustrations and charming rhymes.
It will help your little ones:
to turn the waiting into a time full of fun and productive activities,
to deal with their impulses and to control their reactions,
to understand that after waiting, some amazing things can happen,
to understand that waiting is an integral part of everyday life.
***
You’ll be amazed how many things you can learn while you wait.
***

Teach your children the importance of patience.
This fun picture book can be the first step towards your goal. Your kids will enjoy reading this story as they identify with little Dan and his daily struggles. This book is suitable for all ages and anyone who works with children.

title: Body Boundaries Make Me Stronger | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Body Boundaries Make Me Stronger | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Every parent must navigate the tricky situation of teaching kids about personal boundaries in a healthy, age-appropriate manner. Finding the right personal safety books to do it, however, just got easier with this book about personal space.

Little Nick’s story is a beautifully illustrated consent book for parents to read with their little boys and girls. In this boundaries for kids book, Little Nick experiences several situations that make him uncomfortable, but once he tells his parents, he gains new ways to address the situations.

What Kids Will Learn:

Body safety and awareness
Social skills
Consent for touch and no touch
Good touch, bad touch differentiation
Stranger danger
Little Nick’s story provides a great guide for social emotional learning for kids. All of the situations in the children’s safety books are relatable and useful for teaching consent to children in an age-appropriate manner, whether they’re a boy or girl.

The exceptional story lets kids see who their body belongs to, how to express their feelings in what’s said, what rules they might set up, and when there need to be exceptions to things like underpants for doctors.

This baby and child safety book is great conversation starter that kids can use while learning to read. The social emotional learning book for kids features rhyming text and high-quality illustrations that help children read the story themselves as they learn about good touch, bad touch for kids.

This body safety book for kids also promotes the basics for teaching kids about private parts. This kids’ book about safety increases body awareness for kids and is an excellent addition to any child’s library.

***

Body Boundaries Make Me Stronger is part of a series of social emotional books for kids that explore emotions, feelings, and social skills. This story is designed to help parents talk to their child about self-care, keeping safe, growing up, how to say what makes them uncomfortable, and much more.

description:
Worry Thoughts started out as a rhyming poem that the author wrote for his daughters when they were quite young. It is now an engaging storybook with full-page illustrations that brings the poem to life.

Whether it was reading the poem to them when they were very young, or them reading it to themselves as they got older, the poem helped them reset. Was it the cure-all for all their worries and anxious thoughts, no, not at all, it just became one of many ways that helped them change the relationship they had with their worry thoughts. And that’s what it’s all about.
It teaches yet another coping skill that can help the child feel in control when they have worry thoughts.
It makes for a wonderful storytime book for the parent or teacher to talk about worries and ways to help manage those anxious thoughts.
Also included in the book is a comic strip rendition of the poem as well as the original poem with the hope that the book can always be a go-to for the child as they grow up.

title: If I Were the Teacher | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy

description:
Teaching is hard and creating a thriving classroom environment is even harder. If I Were the Teacher is a read-aloud that helps teachers build a safe and loving community of trust and wonder.

Children love to imagine, and that’s exactly what Max does on the first day of school. He dreams about what he would do if he were the teacher. His ideas are wild, chaotic, and downright hilarious. But in the end, Max realizes that it’s probably good he’s not in charge. He is very thankful for his teacher and decides that if she’s his teacher then he doesn’t want to change a thing.

If I Were the Teacher uses inclusive and humorous illustrations to pull students into the story. This book will promote valuable conversations of imagination and curiosity while deepening the bond of the teacher-student relationship. If I Were the Teacher is a perfect addition for any elementary school teacher’s library.

description:
From Shel Silverstein, New York Times bestselling author of Where the Sidewalk Ends and A Light in the Attic, comes a poignant picture book about love and acceptance, cherished for over fifty years. This classic is perfect for both young readers and lifelong fans.

"Once there was a tree...and she loved a little boy."

So begins a story of unforgettable perception, beautifully written and illustrated by the gifted and versatile Shel Silverstein. This moving parable for all ages offers a touching interpretation of the gift of giving and a serene acceptance of another's capacity to love in return.

Every day the boy would come to the tree to eat her apples, swing from her branches, or slide down her trunk...and the tree was happy. But as the boy grew older he began to want more from the tree, and the tree gave and gave and gave. This is a tender story, touched with sadness, aglow with consolation.

The Giving Tree is a meaningful gift for milestone events such as graduations, birthdays, and baby showers.

Shel Silverstein's incomparable career as a bestselling children's book author and illustrator began with Lafcadio, the Lion Who Shot Back. He is also the creator of picture books including A Giraffe and a Half, Who Wants a Cheap Rhinoceros?, The Missing Piece, The Missing Piece Meets the Big O, and the perennial favorite The Giving Tree, and of classic poetry collections such as Where the Sidewalk Ends, A Light in the Attic, Falling Up, Every Thing On It, Don't Bump the Glump!, and Runny Babbit plus Runny Babbit Returns.

In this rhyming story, Kiara learns how to keep going even when things get too hard. Through colorful illustrations and rhythmic rhymes, Kiara reflects on her mistakes and realizes that mistakes help her grow. Instead of avoiding them, she learns from them so she can improve.

Do you want your child to learn about perseverance and diligence? Your child will learn how easy it is to get back up after failing.

”I Choose to Try Again” is a story with social emotional learning (SEL) in mind. It has been praised by teachers and therapists worldwide.

This story told from Kiara’s point of view will help open your child's mind to what it feels like to fail, and then try again. Kiara will teach your child how to be mentally strong.

With Kiara in real life examples, your child will learn to develop their understanding of their own emotions. Throughout the story, Kiara will show you what perseverance looks like.

Teacher and Therapist Toolbox: I Choose is an empowering series curated to empower young children to become aware of big emotions.

A new book series developed in tandem with teachers and therapists to help children cope with a range of emotions and teach them that they indeed hold the power to choose their actions and reactions.

Try not to say ‘never.’.
That brainwashes you to fail.
It means that you won’t have the chance
To raise the victory sail.

”I Choose to Try Again” was developed alongside counselors and parents to be used as a resource in a social emotional curriculum.

title: My Way to Keep Anger Away Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: My Way to Keep Anger Away Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Do you feel hopeless when you see your child with red cheeks and steam coming out of their ears? Do you need to help your child control big emotions? Look no more! This adorable children’s picture book will help you for sure!

Anger can affect kids of all ages — toddlers, preschoolers, and even older ones — and they behave unlike they usually do. You can’t prevent your child from getting angry, but you can teach them to deal with it in a healthy way.

This anger book for kids will take your child on an underwater adventure to a magical dreamland. Boys and girls will surely enjoy the story where sea animals share anger management tips.

This social-emotional book for kids:

teaches children to deal with anger in a healthy way
offers children calming techniques and activities for anger management
contains beautiful illustrations and rhymes
suits perfectly for preschool kids ages 3-5, as well as older kids ages 6-10
includes extra calming technique and coloring page as a bonus.   
There are many emotion books for kids available. You might wonder what makes this one special. Hundreds of families have already read this adventurous kids’ book and are grateful for the useful tips it provides.

So, even if you have read some of the best children’s books about anger management, you should try this one too!

This anger book is a product of extensive experience working with children. It has been proven through practice that there are ways to calm down every explosive child. The only trick is to find the way that best suits your child!

Take your child on this magical adventure and discover various anger management techniques!

title: Confidence is my Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Confidence is my Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Do you want your kid(s) to feel more confident and capable?
Every child faces low self-esteem and poor self-confidence at least once in their life. Children are often ready to give up on their goals, especially if they encounter obstacles and challenges. We must support them and teach them to believe in themselves.

Failure is the key to success.
After a series of failures at school, little Leonardo feels sad and disappointed. But, by interacting with his parents, he soon realizes that his superpower is, in fact, his self-confidence.

“I am loved! I can choose! I am brave! I am amazing!” These are just some of the mindful affirmations that will help little Leo to overcome difficult situations.

‘Confidence is my superpower’ will help your little ones:
believe in themselves and love themselves as they are,
overcome the fear of failure and understand that failures are one step on the path to success,
ace their negative feelings and turn them into positive ones,
look at life from a brighter side and never give up on their goals,
support each other and help those in need.
From the bestselling author of Kindness is my Superpower.
Light rhymes and colorful illustrations will delight your children. In addition, they will enjoy reading this heart-warming story by identifying with the main character and the situations he encounters.

This book is suitable for all ages, ESPECIALLY those looking for their superpower.

The Team Supercrew Book Series is rooted in cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), a social-emotional therapy that focuses on the ways that our thoughts, emotions, and behaviors are interconnected. Team Supercrew helps children recognize big feelings and have the tools to regulate emotions in a positive way!
The Team Supercrew heroes, Benny the Brave, Keisha the Kind, Chloe the Calm, and Gen the Grit, bring these tools to children and families in a fun, engaging, and unexpected way.

title: My Way to Making Friends Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: My Way to Making Friends Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Would you like to raise your child as a friendly and socially active person? Would you like to teach your kid the ideas of friendships, respect, empathy, sharing, and other skills of healthy social interactions? Then you are at the right place! This lovely kids book about friendship will help you for sure!

Sometimes both preschoolers and school kids may have problems with confidence and may find themselves lost in a company of new children. Well, everyone could face such problems in the childhood. Friendship is a rather complex concept even for the grown-ups, which requires emotional effort and developed social skills. This kids’ book about making new friends will take your child to the sunny Jungle of Friendship. Boys and girls will surely like the adventures of little Melissa and her new adorable animal friends.

This social-emotional book for kids:

teaches children how to make friends
offers children many examples of social activities and friendly behavior
contains lovely illustrations and a light rhyming storyline
suitable for toddlers, preschool kids ages 3 to 5, as well as primary school students of 6-10 years old
contains a number of funny animal characters that children will love from the first sight
There are many books about big emotions available. However, what makes this picture book stand out from other books for kids about making friends is a clear message about what friendship means as well as numerous useful examples of being a good friend to somebody and understanding other people’s feelings and emotions. It also introduces kids to the concepts of kindness, diversity, and inclusion, which are essential for comprehension of the nature of friendship.

Even if you have tried many similar friendship books for kids, this story about little Melissa will surely be an excellent addition to a toolkit!

So, wait no more and take your child on this exciting adventure story about making new friends!

title: Love is My Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Love is My Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Have you heard the question, "Mummy, do you love me?" or "Who do you love the most?"
It's never easy to answer, especially to a little one who thinks your heart belongs only to them.

Bowen is the centre of his parents’ world. But what will happen when baby Bella comes into that world? Will his parents still love him, or will their hearts belong to someone else? Through fun interactions with his mum, Bowen will realise that his heart is big enough to love more than one person at a time.

‘Love Is My Superpower’ will help your children understand how powerful love is.

This book will help your kids in many ways. They will learn:
that there are many different loves,
that their heart can love more people at the same time,
that love means also loving all animals, plants, and everything else that makes up our wonderful world,
that love is healing and kind,
that love can be spread and shared,
that the most important thing is to love yourself.
From the bestselling author of Kindness is my Superpower.
Heartwarming and laced with colourful illustrations, this book will teach your children all about love. If you have a child eager to discover their superpower, this cute book is the right choice for you.

‘Love Is My Superpower’ is suitable for all ages, from preschoolers to early readers.

title: My Way to Kindness Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: My Way to Kindness Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Would you like to raise your child a kind and polite person? Would you like to teach your kid such social skills as empathy, compassion, inclusion, respect, gratitude, and sharing? Then you are at the right place! This lovely kindness book for kids will help you for sure!

Is your child usually kind and polite, but still behaves a bit rude sometimes? Well, everyone might fail to be kind once in a while. Kindness is a very complex skill that requires many social manners. This kids book about kindness will take your child to a magical dreamland of sweets. Boys and girls will surely like the adventures of little Melissa and her new adorable friends.

This social-emotional book for kids:

teaches children to respect elders, help others, share toys, say “thank you”, accept diversity and other social manners
offers children many examples of kind and polite behavior
contains lovely illustrations and a lightly rhyming storyline
suitable both for preschool kids ages 3 to 5, as well as the older ones of 6-10 years old
contains a number of funny characters such as muffin, gingerbread, brownie and donut 

There are many books about big emotions available. However, what makes this picture book stand out from other emotion books for kids is a clear message about what kindness means as well as numerous useful examples of kind deeds and true friendship.

Even if you have tried many similar feelings books for kids, this story about little Melissa will surely be an excellent addition to a toolkit!

So, wait no more and take your child on this exciting adventure story about kindness!

Take your child on this magical adventure and discover various anger management techniques!

description:
**From the best-selling Team Supercrew Series**

I quit! It's too hard! Want to help your child build resilience so they can do hard things? Gen the Grit is here to help!

Jordan wants to quit soccer! He can't kick well, and everyone seems to be telling him different things to do all at the same time. But soccer has always been his favorite sport. Will he really quit? Luckily, Team Supercrew's Gen the Grit knows what Jordan needs most. Time to lace up and get dirty. It's game time!

Team Supercrew's Gen the Grit is here to remind kids that they have the power of Grit inside of them whenever they need it!

Gen the Grit is there to remind Jordan that his worst-case fears are okay, and that he has the power to change these thoughts. He has the power of GRIT, and it just might be closer to find than he thinks.

Tools and tips for parents, teachers, and kids!

The Team Supercrew Book Series is rooted in cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), a social-emotional therapy that focuses on the ways that our thoughts, emotions, and behaviors are interconnected. Our thoughts create our feelings! When we develop the tools to change our negative thoughts, we learn how to regulate our emotions in a positive way.

Team Supercrew helps children recognize big feelings and have the tools to regulate emotions in a positive way!

The Team Supercrew heroes, Benny the Brave, Keisha the Kind, Chloe the Calm, and Gen the Grit, bring these tools to children and families in a fun, engaging, and unexpected way.

There's a hero in all of us. Team Supercrew. Be Extraordinary.

Transform negativity into unshakable optimism, equipping them with resilience to face life's curveballs.
Channel their inner Lucas to cultivate empathy and compassion, laying the groundwork for emotional intelligence.
Thrive in new environments, turning the unknown into an exciting chapter in their ever-growing life story.
Elevate self-confidence and resourcefulness, enabling them to tackle future challenges head-on.

fulltitle: My Heart and Mind: A Children's Book About Learning Emotions and Feelings Read Aloud
description:
My Heart and Mind is a story of Marshal, a kid who is growing and with this growth, he is facing the challenge of managing his feelings and emotions. Understanding emotions and helping kids to help themselves is crucial for parents and teachers to make them able to know, understand and manage their emotions.

Social-emotional learning at the developing stage of a child’s mind is very important. Parents and Teachers have all the responsibility to help kids in learning through social-emotional books which include their favorite characters like Marshal who feel the same as they feel.

We can’t deny that Emotions are the most important aspect of our humanity and my goal is to have children feel comfortable with all of their emotions by seeing their favorite characters like Marshal. This will improve their emotional intelligence and hopefully make them more open to conversations about how things make them feel.

A Colorful picture and Rhyming storybook “My Heart and Mind: A Children’s Book Learning about Feelings and Emotions” the first book from the series “Unlocking the Gold-mine Minds”has been found to be a great help for parenting a child with intense emotions and a perfect teacher and therapists toolbox.

title: The World Works Better Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: The World Works Better Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
We all want the world to work better, but what can we do to help that happen?
As children and as adults, we often feel the desire to improve our lives and the world we live in... but we don't always know how to turn those desires into actions. Sometimes, we don't even know how to express the changes we'd like to create.

This children's nonfiction book, with space-themed illustrations and simple statements about what makes the world work better, provides many simple starting-points for conversation and for action -- opening up topics such as:
Kindness
Support
Positivity
Responsibility
Justice
Thoughtfulness

Teach your children the story that we all implicitly understand, but all too often forget: the story of all the things they already know about how to make our world work better:
Each page in this book finishes a sentence about what makes the world work better, but the end of each sentence is the beginning of a journey... because the story isn't inside this book. The story is inside YOU.
So use this book to spark ideas and inspire meaningful conversations with yourself, with your children, or even with your team at work.
And keep it as a reminder that all the adventure, discovery, and limitless potential of childhood are yours to enjoy -- at any age.

description:
This book is about a Syrian girl's first school day in Canada. It depicts her mixed emotions, as she is happy to be in school again but sad to be away from home. The way her new classmates treat her is crucial to her experience. Every parent has an image in their mind of what their children will be like when they grow up. Being a successful adult starts when children are taught the elements of success from a young age. For example, qualities like love, respect, generosity, care, and kindness foster happy and thriving individuals. It may be easy to practice these habits with friends, but much harder to treat new people this way—even for adults. But if children are taught these elements early on, these positive habits can become second nature. Creating an awareness of the world from a young age will help children to become considerate and caring adults to those around them." Yara, My Friend from Syria" emphasizes two main goals: The first is to plant good qualities into children’s pure hearts, so they may become like fruitful trees as they grow up. The second is to increase children’s awareness of global affairs, which may seem upsetting at times but are the reality of the world around us.

title: A Jillion Ways to Say Goodbye to Your Pet | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: A Jillion Ways to Say Goodbye to Your Pet | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
The passing of a pet can be an emotional challenge for both kids and adults. For many, losing a pet feels like losing a beloved member of the family — and we all grieve in our own ways.

Children may not understand where the array of feelings they are experiencing come from, or are going. And that's okay.

Dealing with a difficult new reality can be a painful process, and learning about the profound but meaningful impact of death is an inevitable part of life.

"A Jillion Ways To Say Goodbye To Your Pet" portrays, without judgment, the emotional impact of pet loss while also explaining that feelings don't last forever and change over time.

Those feelings do not make us good or bad. Those feelings make us human.

This inspiring story about importance of sharing, courage and friendship will help your child:
make new friends and value friendships
share their toys
look on the inside, not judge by appearances
be able to speak up and help their friends in difficult situations
This book will help you discuss important lessons of what it means to be a good friend and bring the best qualities in your child!

board book about friendship for children ages 3-6
cute illustrations with a beautiful rhyming story
not too long, catches the child's attention
printable version includes coloring books
perfect for preschool, pre-k, and kindergarten

title: You Are My Amazing Little Girl Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy

description:
Your baby is wonderful! Isn't she?
She is becoming, day by day a more and more UNIQUE and SPECIAL girl.
This, thanks to the teachings and examples you pass on to her daily.
She is the person who, with a smile brightens your days, even the ones that have not gone as you would like.
This MOTIVATIONAL book, illustrated in COLOR, will take your little one on a journey to increase her self-awareness and confidence.
Often little girls, are scared and worried that they won't be able to do or get what they want because they believe that results must be immediate.
If they do not achieve the goal right away, they become discouraged, doubt their abilities and almost end up giving up.
With their innate optimism, however, they always find the strength to get back up, overcome obstacles and reach GOALS.
Isn't it the same for your CHILD?
She, has extraordinary powers within her, of which she has only to realize.
When she has made them her own, she will be able to achieve and attain anything.
Yes, because she is your WONDERFUL BABY.

What you will find in this book:
An introspective path with small exercises and reflections to do.
Why she is a WONDERFUL BABY.
Why She is Unique.
She will address the issue of DIVERSITY as a tool for UNION.
She will reflect on why she is a STRONG person.
She will look at Mistakes positively and as catalysts for IMPROVEMENT.
Why she is COURAGEOUS.
She will reflect on HER BODY.
THE SUPERPOWER of the word NO.
She will ask for help from people she trusts.
She will reflect on her DREAMS and why she can REACH them.

Little girls love this book because.
It develops confidence in themselves and their abilities
It helps them overcome shyness and anxiety
It helps them see diversity in a positive way
It helps them have a positive attitude toward mistakes and failures
It helps them focus on their goals
It helps them to be self-aware
It helps them to give importance to their THOUGHTS
It is in FULL COLOR
At the end of the book you will find 2 coloring pages from two of our children's coloring books.

There were no people but there lived some gnomes  who seemed to be studying all the time. And books   grew from the ground. "What a lovely planet!  Shall we visit another one?" suggested Helsius. They began to fly and soon saw another planet.  "What amazing colors it has. Let's take a closer   look!" said Dren. When they landed, they could  tell that something was wrong. They landed on another planet  where there were lots of animals.   The sky was red and the rivers were yellow. A  very beautiful giant butterfly approached them.   "Hello, my name is Cynthia. Welcome  to our planet It's called Serus." "Your planet is wonderful!" said Dren. "I  have never seen a planet with so much water,   so much vegetation, and so much food."  "Yes, we are very lucky." said Cynthia.   After staying for a while,  they went to see more planets. They saw a very small black  planet and landed on it.   There didn't seem to be anybody around. And  it was very hot. They came across a snake.   "Hello snake, what's your name?" Helsius  asked. "And why is this planet so empty?" My name is Marty. There's  hardly anyone left here now.   All the trees were cut down and the animals had  nowhere to live. "What a disaster!" Helsius cried.   "Many polluting gases were released that  covered the sky and overheated the planet.   That's why it's so hot here," continued  Marty. "It's because we  consumed more water than we needed.   Also to rain you need water vapor from plants,  and there aren't any left." Marty said. title: The Clean Green Dragon Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: The Clean Green Dragon Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
So, there was this dragon. Yeah, he was mighty, with all the power of the sun and the earth at his wingtips but he was also a little lazy. One day, an annoying problem washed up on his doorstep. Well no, it was more than annoying, it was downright disgusting. The question is would he get off his scaly butt and do something about it?

A fun tale that tells us to look over our shoulder every once in a while to check if we are leaving this planet better or worse than we found it.

From the author: "I was trying to write a legend. As if once there was a planet with an environmental problem and this is how it was solved, and now it is just a story that we tell to our children, like :"children used to sweep chimneys for a job and we used to throw rubbish in the sea, but then we stopped because it was dumb". I wrote a fun simplistic story about our responsibilities to the environment, specifically about single-use plastics (one of our most ridiculous inventions ever) and how our oceans are expected to wash it all away. "

title: Ebony and Her Crown: An Inspirational Poem about Positive Self-Image Read Aloud
fulltitle: Ebony and Her Crown: An Inspirational Poem about Positive Self-Image Read Aloud
description:
This story was written to inspire young children to love the skin they're in. Ebony and her crown highlight the perspective of a curious toddler having a big afro and is uncertain about the nature of her hair. Ebony then turns to her mother for answers. In this mother-daughter duo, Ebony's mother helps her to understand that her hair is meant to be big and wild, and she should wear it with pride. This book is a reminder that social conditioning starts when you are young and follows you into your adult years. When children are able see themselves represented as the main characters in books and television shows, the experience can boost self-esteem and self-worth. Lack of representation can be harmful to a child and can impact their self-image and how they interact with others. A positive self-image can boost our mental, social, and emotional well-being.

Krenn York has published The Grump Hump, A Mood, a Monster, and Making Things Right, illustrated by Anastthesia Kodak. This is actually the second book by Kenorc on this channel. She published The Feather, a story of new beginnings, and I'll leave a link to that story so you can follow along after you finish this one. But Krenn is a good friend of the channel, and I'm so excited to see that she's published this brand new story. So, with that said, let's start this new adventure. This book is dedicated to every busy household that will occasionally host a grump hump. This too shall pass. There once was a boy who was in a slump. He held his head so low that he grew a hump. All day long he looked at the ground. crossing his arms and wearing a frown. His breakfast was cold, his sister too pesky, his hair stuck out, and his room was messy. A stormy cloud trailed above his head and assumed he should just stay in bed. His mom said, "Son, why are you down in the dumps? There is no sense in being a grump." He buried deep in his pillow, covered his head, and moaned. That's what everybody says. "Well, son, you can't keep feeling sorry for yourself. Being a grump hump is bad for your health. His sister peeped in and set a note by the bed. This is what her letter said. Dear brother, I'm sorry you've been so sad that everything I do has been making you mad. I miss sitting with you on the bus and wish I could play without making you fuss. Please cheer up soon and out of the frump. I want back my brother. No more grump hump, sister. He wiped a tear from his cheek. He had been a grump hump this whole week. He realized he wanted to make things right before he and sister called it a night. He knocked on the door and paused for a beat. "Hey, can I come in?" he said soft and sweet. "Sister, I feel some regret after reading your letter. I know I've been cranky and want to do better. I'll ask for some space the next time I feel down to let off some steam and turn things around. So, I'm sorry for treating you badly this week. I'd like to start over after some sleep. Sister agreed. You were having a hard time. That's easy to see. But talking like this means a lot to me. When you're upset, I'll let you unwind and give you some space to clear your mind. Thanks for saying you're sorry. That takes heart. In the future, we'll both try to do our part. Mom hugged them both and said, "That was so sweet. You two have had lots of emotions this week, son. Your apology was thoughtful and brave. Just know we will all have our bad fussy days. The important thing is to express our regret when we mistreat others or show disrespect. I'm proud of how you made things right. We'll see you in the morning. We love you. Good night. The next morning, he came to breakfast and smiled. "Well," said Mom, "We haven't seen that in a while." He cleaned his plate, then asked for more. He played with sister, then did some chores. As he headed for school, he saw something weird. That hump on his back had plain disappeared. So, the next time you find yourself in a mood, send your grump hump packing with a new attitude. Thank you pioneers for reading with us today to the book The Grump Hump written by Kren York. description:
"Bear Barry" by Darija Veg is an adorable tale about a lovable bear who just can't seem to shake off his sleepy habits. Every morning, Barry wakes up with a big yawn and a rumble in his tummy, setting off on a quest for food in the forest. But his friends keep running away from him, leaving Barry puzzled and sad.

With the help of a wise owl and some valuable advice from "The Book of Manners," Barry learns that his loud yawns and stained teeth from late-night snacks are scaring his forest friends. Determined to change, Barry starts going to bed earlier and covering his mouth with a paw when he yawns. Soon, his yawns disappear, and he finds himself surrounded by old and new friends, enjoying the forest together.

"Bear Barry" is a heartwarming story that teaches children the importance of good manners, consideration for others, and the value of a good night's sleep. With charming illustrations and a relatable protagonist,

Evidence-based calming strategies for kids
Emotion regulation for kids

Lieve de Lint is a mother of three and loves stories, both to write, and to dissect with clients because she believes stories create our life experiences. Lieve de Lint is an IFS Therapy informed coach & psychologist who works with parents and professionals and with teams at UC Berkeley. Lieve works with clients who want to feel whole, calm, and at home within themselves so they can create their desired life.

description:

The Tales of Meadowbrook Hollow: Grandfather Rabbit’s Scheme has the makings of a classic children’s book and has been compared to the style used by Beatrix Potter in her classic The Tale of Peter Rabbit. Through well-written dialog and excellent storytelling, each character’s personality shines through and is brought to life. The colorful and marvelous artwork in this fully illustrated picture book creates an even greater sense of immersion, further drawing the reader into this heartfelt tale. Grandfather Rabbit’s Scheme carries the young reader along a journey that clearly depicts how a little bit of love can go a long way, how one good turn deserves another, and how determination and perseverance can pay off.

It is the story of a young bunny, named Alex, who leads an effort that not only saves his dear friend but also changes the way that much of the world views springtime. Alex is joined by his wise grandfather who develops a plan that ultimately reshapes the thinking of Farmer Groucher. There are other memorable characters, such as Stephie and Raya, who join Grandfather Rabbit and help him to carry out his plan. Mrs. Ponders and Mrs. Brussel bring more life to the adventure and provide shining, wholesome examples of supportive parents. There is also Myra, a prudent old hen, whose good deed and quandary can be found at the heart of Grandfather Rabbit’s Scheme.

This tale resonates regardless of its seasonal setting and is even more special in the springtime. It makes for a wonderful and wholesome bedtime story.

description:
Do you have a little one who sometimes throws food, toys, or objects when they feel angry, upset or want attention? Then this no throwing toddler picture book can be a perfect gift for your child to manage big emotions and develop self esteem.

This fun-filled, colorfully illustrated, comprehensive yet concise book gently teaches toddlers why hands are not for throwing, what to do when you feel like throwing, and offers playful, engaging alternatives to use their hands for kindness, creativity, and fun!

What’s inside this book?
Why children throw things: Kids will relate to the reasons why they throw things, whether it's for attention, out of frustration and rage, for showing temper tantrums, or just for being silly.
Why throwing is bad: Through fun examples, toddlers will learn the consequences of throwing things, like hurting others or breaking something special, making them realize violence is never okay, and hands are not for hurting, but helping.
How to control the urge to throw: Offers creative strategies and tips, like clapping, squeezing a stuffed animal, scribbling a picture, deep breathing, or simply talking to someone, to help children control their emotions, manage anger, and to teach toddler to stay calm.
What are hands for: Hands are for much more than throwing! Little people will discover how their “gentle hands” can be used to play, create, help, and express kindness and love.

Perfect for Toddlers, Preschoolers, Kindergarteners, and Little Ones of every age
A perfect addition to any child's bookshelf, encouraging healthy emotional development while entertaining them at the same time.

Colorful and engaging illustrations: Fun, big, eye-catching pictures with whimsical actions will captivate young readers and hold their attention.
Simple Language: Clear, easy-to-follow, age-appropriate and kid-friendly writing that toddlers can understand and relate to. The playful, colorful text perfectly complements the vibrant illustrations.
Teaches kindness and creativity: Promotes the idea that hands are for sharing, creating, and helping, not for throwing.

Great for Parents, Preschool Teachers, Childcare Providers, and Caregivers
Excellent teaching tool for parents and educators to help children understand the importance of using their hands in positive, thoughtful ways.
It's perfect for read-aloud sessions, or as part of a classroom lesson on emotions, positive behavior, and good manners.

Perfect For:
Parents and children seeking an educational yet fun read
Elementary Teachers aiming to teach emotional regulation and kindness in the classroom
Gifts for birthdays, holidays, or any occasion

cleaned_subtitles: Kind: captions Language: en Welcome back, pioneers. I'm excited to introduce a new pioneer and author to the channel, Whimsy Mama, who published Hands Are Not for Throwing Things. This book was designed to teach toddlers about kindness and self-control. I'm so ready to read this book and share the many ways we can teach young kids how to use their hands when dealing with big emotions properly. Are you ready? Let's begin. You want your big brother to see your cool toy, but he's not looking. So, you throw it at him. Oops. You're excited to show Mama your drawing, but she's on the phone, so you throw your crayon to make her look. Uh-oh. You want your dog to play with you, so you throw a stone to call her. Roof. You don't want to eat your food, so you throw your spoon. You want to make everyone laugh during snack, so you throw your apple up in the air. You are so angry because your puzzle piece won't fit, so you throw it across the room. Your best friend is talking with someone else, so you throw your ball at him. Flack. When you throw things at someone, they could get hurt. Oops, that wasn't fun. When you throw your food, it makes a big mess. Yikes. Throwing things could hurt your pet. You didn't mean to, but your dog got scared and ran away. Your toy is so fun to play with, but when you throw, it might break. Oops. Throwing things around can break your mom's favorite vase. Oh no, now mama is upset. Throwing things can make your friends upset and they might not want to play with you anymore. Throwing things at the wall can leave messy stains and make it look dirty. If you feel like throwing, clap your hands instead. Clap clap clap and feel better. When you want to throw, wiggle your fingers like a spider. Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle. It's so silly and fun. When you want to throw, jump up and down like a bunny. Hop, hop, hop to feel bouncy and happy again. Imagine you're a dragon breathing out fire. Take a deep breath in through your nose and blow out through your mouth like a mighty dragon. If you're feeling upset, you can sing loudly. La, I feel so free. If you're angry, do a silly dance. Wiggle your arms and shake your hips. It's so much fun. When you want attention, talk to your parents. Can you look at me? They'll love to listen. If you feel like crying, hug your mama and papa instead. A big hug will make you feel safe and loved. When you feel like throwing, squeeze a soft, squishy toy. It feels so good. [clears throat] If you feel like throwing, stomp your feet like an elephant. Stomp, stomp, stomp. It helps you get all your energy out. If you feel like throwing, count to 10 with your fingers. It helps you feel calm again. Close your eyes and think of your favorite place, a sunny beach or a magical forest. It makes you feel calm and happy. If you want to throw, make silly faces in the mirror. It'll make you laugh and you will forget you wanted to throw. When you feel upset, give a big hug to your teddy bear. It feels so cozy. When you want to throw, pretend to be a superhero. Strike a cool superhero pose and feel strong and brave. When you want to throw your food, say it to your mama. She can help you with your plate. Hands are not for throwing things. Hands are for sharing your toys with friends. Hands are for drawing hearts. Draw a heart for your mama and make her day brighter. Hands are for feeding your dog. Give him food and see him wag his tail with joy. Hands are for making shadow puppets. Use your hands to make funny animals on the wall. Hands are for watering plants so that they can grow tall and strong. Hands are for drawing beautiful pictures. Hands are for helping your friend stand back up when he falls down. Hands are for helping grandma bake cookies. Stir the butter and help put cookies on the tray. Hands are for building a tall tower with blocks. Hands are for high-fiving your friend. Hands are for playing music. Hands are for turning pages of your book. Go on an adventure with your favorite story. Hands are for holding hands. Hold your papa's hand and walk together with a big smile. Hands are for making wishes. Close your eyes, join your hands, and make a wish. Hands are for counting stars. Your hands are special. They help you do so many amazing things. So remember, hands are not for throwing things. Hands are for love, laughter, and all the good things you can do. title: The Rhyming Tales of Mimi the Moon Princess: The Making of a Princess Read Aloud
fulltitle: The Rhyming Tales of Mimi the Moon Princess: The Making of a Princess Read Aloud
description:
The Rhyming Tales of Mimi the Moon Princess: The Making of a Princess captivates readers with a tale of young Mimi, a ten-year-old girl, and her new friend, Chandra, a lonely little buck from the nearby woods. Although Mimi has never seen a deer and Chandra has never seen a girl, their purity and innocence draw them together in the joys of fun and frolic.

Their friendship sprouts and then blossoms over the months. One day, however, Chandra fails to visit Mimi, leaving her all alone. With a bit of fear, Mimi darts into the woods in search of her friend. The trees get thickens, making it more difficult to see clearly; Mimi then stumbles on a stone and gently tumbles to the ground. When she raises her head, she sees a moon-lit path leading to the sky; Chandra mystically races from the sky, down the path to be by Mimi’s side.

What a magnificent friendship, from which magic evolves. What marvelous surprise could the universe have in store for the two? Where does their reality end and fantasy begin; or, are they one and the same?


Filled with absolute awe and wonder, The Making of a Princess will captivate young readers. The poetic language and rhyming text make this tale an utter joy to read for adults and children alike. With dual messages that dreams can come true, and children can help make the world more whole, The Making of a Princess is both fun and inspirational. E.W. Rhodes and S.B. Christian have created a true children’s masterpiece that belongs in the hands of every child. The gorgeous illustrations delicately bring the story to life and envelope the reader in a mystical land of wonder and amazement. Rhodes and Christian have designed a world of imagination that hasn’t been seen for decades. The Making of a Princess is a piece of magic you absolutely need in your home!

title: The Magical Adventures of Detective Sam | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: The Magical Adventures of Detective Sam | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
A classic lesson in preparing kids to defend themselves against bullies, told in a children’s book through the character Detective Sam, a dog with superpowers (hearing, speed, inventiveness). When Diego, a child in Flagstone Elementary, is bullied by another kid, Barry, Sam teleports himself to the school and comes to the aid of Diego, who is left without his lunch money.

Instead of using his superpowers, Sam prepares Diego to take care of himself with a four-part course that every child should know: using strong body language to fend off bullish advances; defending against violent behavior and preventing yourself from getting hurt; breaking the cycle of violence to never retaliate and control anger; and informing a teacher or adult. title: He, They, She? I am ME! | Reading Pioneers Academy Read Aloud
fulltitle: He, They, She? I am ME! | Reading Pioneers Academy Read Aloud
description:
Lo doesn't like to wear dresses or play with dolls. One day, they discover a colorful, magical world filled with choices and possibilities. Join Lo on an adventure of freedom and wonder, where they learn that being true to oneself is the greatest magic of all!

Children grow up in a world shaped by gender stereotypes. They are surrounded by social cues and expectations that can pressure them to conform to societal norms based on their sex. This may leave children feeling confused or distressed when they don't fit into these pre-constructed molds.

This book encourages children to follow their hearts and embrace their true selves. Gender is not assigned at birth—it is fluid. What is considered masculine or feminine changes over time and varies by culture. This story shows children that the way they choose to express their gender is not fixed. It celebrates each child’s uniqueness and affirms their identity.

A great book that sparks conversation. The rhyming, poetic text and magical illustrations will have children reaching for it again and again!

This social-emotional book for kids:

Helps children and adults address emotions related to gender identity and expression.
Encourages conversations on acceptance and embracing one’s identity.
Supports parent-child relationships.
Contains glossy, 8.25 x 8.25 inch premium, beautifully illustrated pages, making it appealing to young readers.
Suits kids ages 4-12.
Is perfect for young readers and beyond.
Is an excellent resource for counselors, therapists, parents, and teachers alike.
Includes a page at the end of the book explaining gender affirming references, imagery and symbolism.

As the symphony floated above, Sora searched deep inside for a song. But nothing came. Melodies tickled across Sora's toes, legs, and back as the little cricket searched in vain for a song.

Then a stern voice pierced the night, and the music stopped. "Someone's not singing."

Readers are invited to stretch, balance, jump, and move along with all the creatures in this delightful story of perseverance and celebrating your own unique voice.

Sora Searches for a Song is ideal for ages 5-8. It features Sora (no pronouns), birds, fish, frogs, dragonflies, turtles, snakes and more. Ballerina Konora joins each page with optional ideas to explore dance fundamentals. As kids move along with the characters and Ballerina Konora, they explore head/tail connection, dynamic posture, vestibular action, balance, movement quality, partnering, and more.

This magical blanket is his source of comfort and security, during times of fear and uncertainty, a symbol of their unbreakable bond. But one day, disaster strikes, and Winston's cherished blanket goes missing, leaving him in a state of panic and despair.
Spotting the distressed bunny, a team of compassionate and understanding animals join him in his search without hesitation.

Parents, educators, grief counselors and psychologists agree that this children’s book about grief and loss is a powerful tool to help children create their own special memories. Carrying similar messages such as The Invisible String, The Rabbit Listened, God Gave Us Heaven, and The Memory Box, children will have a better understanding of the special bond that can never be broken even after loss.

This extraordinary keepsake gift is also a great conversation starter in class. Children can learn to empathize with those experiencing loss as well as think of creating their own memory box.

With beautiful, colorful illustrations, this book is perfect for children aged 4 to 8 and a great tool for grief counselors, therapists, psychologists, parents and teachers.

title: Kai Po Che: Mini's Perfect Kite | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Kai Po Che: Mini's Perfect Kite | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
“Kai Po Che! I’ve cut the kite!” Mini discovers that flying her own perfect diamond during Makar Sankranti requires equal parts creativity, compassion, and courage in order to truly soar.

It’s Makar Sankranti, the Indian festival of kites, and Mini wants to join in the fun. But her older brother insists that flying kites is not for little girls. Using her craft-making skills, Mini constructs her own not-so-perfect kite and learns to fly it with her brother’s help. But during Sankranti, it’s fair game to cut another kite’s string and keep it as your own! When a red kite comes along and causes a KITE-ASTROPHE, Mini decides it’s time to challenge the red kite to a battle in the sky. In the end, she discovers that her not-so-perfect kite is really her very own perfect diamond.

Suhasini Gupta and Devika Oza create an exciting story filled with culture, determination, and the love between siblings. Filled with stunning, richly-colored illustrations and including an author's note and back matter about Sankranti and the math and science of kite flying, this book will make a delightful addition to library story times, read-alouds at home and in classrooms, and is sure to have kids shouting “Kai Po Che” and making kites of their own.

description:
My Worst Best Friend Bundle #1 is a compilation of the first four books in Julie Cavacco's humorous My Worst Best Friend series. These stories are great for emerging readers, but also have great appeal to readers of all levels. The series features the familiar antics and conflicts often found between good friends with different natures and highlights the rewards and challenges of childhood friendship.

Originally written for a late-reading fifth grade boy. He couldn't find a book that he was willing to read at his reading level because the books available in the library, where she was a children's librarian, were too "babyish". it has appealed to early readers, reluctant readers, school psychologists, ESL students, and adult students who never mastered a higher level of reading who are working on becoming fully literate.

They've been in classrooms as an option for silent reading periods where a student at any level can pick up the book and not feel like they are reading a "little kid's" book. Julie observed, after years of substituting at the elementary school level, that behavior and self-esteem are tied into the ability to read. She has seen success and how it can improve both behavior and self-esteem as students become stronger readers.

title: Stories of Red Rat and Red Hen: Volume 6 Read Aloud ~ Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Stories of Red Rat and Red Hen: Volume 6 Read Aloud ~ Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Stories of Red Rat and Red Hen: Volume 6 Read Aloud ~ Reading Pioneers Academy

Stories of the Red Rat and the Red Hen help children learn to read by introducing vowel sounds in a logical progression. Beginning with the five single vowels in their long and short forms, the first and second volumes progressively incorporate oo and ee; ai, ou, oa, and ea; silent gh; and ould. The third and fourth volumes emphasize soft g, soft c, silent k, and other oddities of the language. The Red Rat’s Book of Vowels and Consonants contains stories about nonconformist letters, the red rat’s report on the vowels, and interviews with the vowels themselves about their virtues and challenges. It should be read aloud early on to familiarize your child with the vagaries of pronunciation. The early stories are told primarily in one-syllable words that conform to phonics rules. Longer words that intrigue young children and are easy to sound out, like amnesia, are sprinkled throughout to add a thrill and boost confidence. Volumes 5 and 6 contain more complex stories about challenges that the red rat faces. The words are widely spaced to separate them visually. Each page has a border to help confine the reader’s attention to the page. The illustrations give clues to the identity of words but do not constrain the reader’s imagination. The large pictures and text allow the child to turn pages often, giving a sense of competence. The stories are engaging to both children and adults as the red rat talks with the hen about his challenges with other rodents and resolves his concerns. Unfortunately, the letter names that we say when reciting the alphabet are rarely the sounds that those letters make in a word. If you plan to use this series of books to teach your child to read, you and your beginning reader should watch a video of the 44 phonemes (sounds) of English (the Youtube video by Literacy How is good) on a daily basis for two weeks. Repeating the sounds every day will give your reader the background necessary to decode the words in the book.

fulltitle: Stories of the Red Rat and the Red Hen Vol 7 Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
This series is intended to help adults help teach children how to read with phonics. The first two books introduce beginning readers to the vowel sounds chapter by chapter. As the stories progress, they include longer words that are phonetically consistent. The fifth, sixth, and seventh volumes bring in the most complex ideas and have the longest stories. These books build upon one another. They are intended to be read with a child or read aloud to a child. Some of the allusions are there for the enjoyment of the adult reading along. There are many points at which the reader and the adult might want to talk about issues raised or unfamiliar vocabulary. Most of the stories have an open ending that invites the reader to draw his own conclusions about what happens next. My hope is that the adult reading with the child will become engaged in the book as well and will share the experience of enjoying a book with the child.

title: Doggy Jitters | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
fulltitle: Doggy Jitters | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
Doggy Jitters is written in fun poetic language and introduces the reader to sounds and situations that might make our pets anxious or scared. What do many dogs do when they hear the rain beat down on the roof or the thunder flash in the sky? Find out how one little dog handles her fears, and how you can help your dog overcome her fears.

Dogs have a keen sense of hearing. This means they can hear sounds that humans can't even hear.
Sometimes dogs are very sensitive to certain sounds and become nervous or anxious.
Paying attention to the noises around you might help identify what makes your pet fearful.
Help your pet avoid these triggers and comfort him or her when they happen.
Talk to your veterinarian to discover what you can do to help your pet overcome the jitters!
